title: Electrocardiographic Imaging via Posterior Sampling under Operator Discrepancy
abstract: arXiv:2611.17851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electrocardiographic imaging (ECGI) reconstructs heart-surface potentials from body-surface potentials, an ill-posed inverse problem. Diffusion posterior samplers combine a learned prior with an explicit forward operator that they assume to be accurate. In ECGI this operator is only an estimate, because the body changes with respiration and posture, and body composition such as subcutaneous fat is rarely known for an individual patient. The resulting operator discrepancy is structured and depends on the heart signal. We introduce OpDis-PS, a diffusion posterior sampler that models this discrepancy instead of treating it as signal-independent noise. OpDis-PS learns how the discrepancy depends on the signal, folds this into a corrected forward operator, and reconstructs with a fixed prior across all operator conditions. We study two realistic sources of discrepancy, changing lung conductivity and an added subcutaneous-fat layer. Across bot

translated_title: 算子差异下基于后验采样的心电成像
translated_abstract: 心电成像（ECGI）旨在从体表电位重建心脏表面电位，这是一个病态逆问题。扩散后验采样器将学习到的先验与显式前向算子相结合，并假设该算子是准确的。然而在ECGI中，该算子仅是一个估计值，因为人体会随呼吸和姿势发生变化，而且皮下脂肪等个体身体成分通常难以获知。由此产生的算子差异是结构化的，并且依赖于心脏信号。我们提出了OpDis-PS，一种对这种差异进行建模的扩散后验采样器，而不是将其视为与信号无关的噪声。OpDis-PS学习差异如何依赖于信号，将其融入修正后的前向算子中，并在所有算子条件下使用固定的先验进行重建。我们研究了两种现实的差异来源：肺部电导率的变化以及皮下脂肪层的存在。
tldr: 提出OpDis-PS方法，通过学习并对信号依赖的算子差异进行建模，将其融入修正后的前向算子，从而在算子不精确的现实条件下实现更准确的心电成像重建。
en_tdlr: OpDis-PS is a diffusion posterior sampler that models signal-dependent operator discrepancy and incorporates it into a corrected forward operator, enabling more accurate ECGI reconstruction under realistic operator uncertainty.
